newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to trade Leucadia, West TeleServices options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to trade Leucadia, West TeleServices options.

text.p: American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Tuesday it will trade options on shares of Leucadia National Corp and West TeleServices Corp beginning June 4.
Leucadia options will open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35 and initial expirations in June, July, September and December. Position limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
Highland Securities Co will be the specialist.

For West TeleServices options, opening strikes will be 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2. Initial expirations have been set for June, July, September and December. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
Susquehanna Investment Group has been named specialist.
